props.gloss_en: the mishnah: on the second [Shabbat they read] Zakhor
Rav: when Purim falls on Friday, they advance the Zakhor portion [to the previous Shabbat]
Rav's reason: so that the doing not precede the remembering
Shmuel's reply: since there are walled cities that observe on the fifteenth, the doing and the remembering come together
Rav Pappa: what is 'second'? second to the interruption
the baraita: which is the second Shabbat? any [week] within which Purim falls, even on Friday
Shmuel: [read the baraita as] 'on it' (בה) [rather than 'within it']
Rav Huna: when [Purim] falls on Shabbat itself, according to all they do not advance
Rav Nachman: it is still a dispute
Rav (via R' Chiyya bar Abba, via R' Abba): Purim that falls on Shabbat -- one advances and reads Zakhor on the previous Shabbat
